page_title: BET 1-1 RMA | Betis v Real Madrid 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+7' Chadi Riad (Betis) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the roof of the net, but Andriy Lunin pulls off a decent save to deny him.
90+6' Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempts to find Rodrygo with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90+2' A corner kick by Real Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Rui Silva (Betis).

90+1' Wow, what an escape. Joselu (Real Madrid) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Isco (Betis) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
89' Isco (Betis) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

89' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Abner (Betis) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
88' A cross by Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

86' The ball rebounds to Willian Jose (Betis) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
85' Betis fail to score from a corner as Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.

85' Assane Diao (Betis) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
83' Substitution. Lucas Vazquez makes his way off the pitch and Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
83' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nico Paz (Real Madrid) replacing Toni Kroos.
83' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luiz Henrique (Betis) for Ayoze Perez.
82' Ayoze Perez (Betis) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
80' Real Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

80' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Rui Silva to dive and make a save. It will be a corner kick for Real Madrid.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Brahim Diaz will be replaced by Joselu (Real Madrid).
78' It must be a yellow card. It is. Aitor Ruibal (Betis) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
77' Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Rui Silva comes off the line to clear the ball away.
76' The free kick is taken by Toni Kroos (Real Madrid), but ball is cleared.
75' Cesar Soto Grado blows the whistle, Isco (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Real Madrid are awarded the free kick.
73' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul. Betis win a free kick.
71' Isco (Betis) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luka Modric trots off the pitch and is replaced by Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid).
70' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Sergi Altimira will be replaced by Andres Guardado (Betis).
69' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is cleared.

68' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.

66' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Aitor Ruibal (Betis) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. Andriy Lunin just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
65' The attendance is 52756.
64' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
62' Willian Jose (Betis) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
61' Abde Ezzalzouli will be replaced by Assane Diao (Betis).

58' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
57' Ayoze Perez (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Andriy Lunin comes off his line to gather the ball.
56' Some neat passing and movement from Real Madrid as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

53' 0 - 1 Goal! Brahim Diaz displays great vision and sends a pass to Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:1.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.

51' Great save! Isco (Betis) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Andriy Lunin. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Betis.

50' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
47' A corner kick by Betis is thwarted by the well prepared Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid).
47' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Close! David Alaba (Real Madrid) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but Rui Silva punches the ball away.

42' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
42' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

42' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
42' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

41' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Rui Silva! Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
39' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
39' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
37' Betis take a short corner kick.
36' Good clearance! Ayoze Perez (Betis) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Betis earn a corner.
33' Willian Jose (Betis) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
32' Willian Jose (Betis) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
32' Betis get a corner.
32' Ayoze Perez (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
31' Ayoze Perez (Betis) collects a rebound and his promising attempt goes towards the roof of the net, but Andriy Lunin keeps it out with an amazing save.
31' David Alaba (Real Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
25' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) but poses no threat. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Real Madrid.
24' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
21' Real Madrid keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
17' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
16' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

12' The cross into the penalty area from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
11' A pass lands at the feet of Isco (Betis) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
10' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
8' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends a chip pass into the box, but Rui Silva is quickest to intercept the ball.

7' Rui Silva doesn't have to worry about that one. Rodrygo puts a cross in towards Luka Modric (Real Madrid), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
5' Real Madrid produce a short pass from the free kick.
5' German Pezzella (Betis) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Real Madrid.

3' Marc Roca (Betis) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies low towards the middle of the net, but Andriy Lunin is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Betis will have the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will supervise the game today.
